builds.name: Galeforce Fighter
builds.desc: Goal of this build is to hit an enemy, proc galeforce, and get out or kill a 2nd unit. Heavy blade seal ensures we gain 2 charges per attack, with LnD prf and fury giving Raven +8 attack, Raven will fine it more difficult to land 2 hits on enemies than have to worry about proccing heavy blade seal. You may very well end up initiating onto green or even red units just so you can proc galeforce in 1 turn before getting out or moving on to kill a 2nd unit. Desperation allows Raven to keep on going, very useful in chain modes where your HP level will carry over from each map. Wings of Mercy can be considered for grand conquest where having multiple wings of mercy and galeforce allies prove very valuable in dealing with the infinite spawn of enemies. Your C slot is flexible depending on what your team needs.

builds.name: The Surviving Mercenary
builds.desc:
The idea for this build came to me a while back, and I tried it out on him. It is slightly unusual in that it utilizes Miracle to allow Raven to stay alive after going in as a glass cannon. I have found Miracle to be extremely useful in ensuring Raven's survivability against Ignis/Glacies (or other related skill) users, or just large threats in general. With a built-in Life and Death in his refined unique weapon and an additional stat buff from either Fury or a second Life and Death, Heavy Blade is guaranteed to trigger twice, considering Raven's overwhelming Atk and Spd. This will fully charge Miracle, even if he is attacking a ranged unit, allowing him to survive the next instance of combat regardless of the enemy unit's stats or specials (unless Brave weapons). For his B slot, Desperation 3 would allow him to charge his Miracle instantly if already injured. I also experimented with Renewal 3, as I thought that the healing after being brought down to 1 health could provide conditions to trigger Miracle again. The C slot is flexible; I just stuck with Threaten Def 3 because him surviving one turn next to an enemy would trigger it anyway. I tried something with Infantry Pulse 3, but that would depend on the other units on the team.
Although this build may not be ideal in many competitive situations, I still found it to be really useful in defeating certain maps where I needed guaranteed survivability. I had a lot of fun making this build and trying out the many skills for it. Any feedback would be greatly appreciated. Thanks!
